verdict: Paid campaigns are off; organic reach is softening this week.
narrative: All activity this period came from organic sources — paid advertising on Meta and Google carried zero spend and zero leads across the full 28 days, so your Google Business Profile and social presence are carrying the full load. GBP delivered 93 actions this period, including 20 calls and 29 direction requests, but engagement dropped 40% in the last 7 days, with the final three days showing no recorded actions at all — a confirmed dip, not a data blip. Instagram reach followed a similar pattern, falling 38% week-over-week. We're addressing the GBP visibility drop and reviewing what's needed to bring paid campaigns back online so organic slowdowns don't go unmatched.
